constellations.summary: The Pyro Archon riding the Flamestrider motorbike for blazing mobile on-field attacks or off-field coordinated strikes.
Increases Nightsoul point transmission efficiency and grants partywide +20% ATK.
Nightsoul attacks ignore 30% of enemy DEF and refund Energy.
Extends Nightsoul Blessing duration and increases Burst explosion radius.
Enables permanent Flamestrider overdrive with continuous CRIT bonuses and flame shockwaves.
